name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.
texts: Move the ball away (blocker_moved) before taking the key (has_door_key).
Do not drop the key while the door is still closed (avoid key_lost).
Whenever the key is held, open the door now or later (has_door_key → eventually door_open).
Open the door (door_open) before picking up the box (target_picked_up).
Eventually pick up the target box (target_picked_up).
